throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. Extra counters per instruction (normalized by 8 lanes): 0xfa=2.00. The measured CPI 0.4988 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
